reviewer_notes: Verified against the source problem formulation. The domain, codomain and C1 differentiability assumption are preserved.
No constraints or additional optimisation assumptions have been introduced.
Verified that stationarity is stated only as a necessary condition for a differentiable local minimizer.
The conclusion uses the gradient evaluated at x* and is not presented as sufficient.
Verified the distinction between the positive-semidefinite necessary condition and positive-definite sufficient condition.
The sufficient condition correctly concludes that x* is a strict local minimizer under the C2 assumption.
Verified the L-Lipschitz gradient definition, Euclidean norm and universal quantification over x and y.
The item does not confuse gradient Lipschitz continuity with function-value Lipschitz continuity.
Verified the upper-bound direction, gradient inner-product term and coefficient L/2.
The result remains conditional on L-smoothness.
Verified the differentiable first-order characterization of convexity.
The lower-bound direction and quantification over all x and y are preserved.
Verified the strong-convexity lower bound, positive mu assumption and coefficient mu/2.
The sign and squared-norm term are preserved.
Verified the C2 Hessian characterizations for smooth convex and strongly convex objectives.
The convexity qualification for the two-sided Hessian bound is retained.
Verified that the condition number is defined as kappa=L/mu under simultaneous L-smoothness and mu-strong convexity.
The lower bound kappa>=1 is consistent with the source assumptions.
Verified the current-iterate gradient evaluation, negative update direction and positive step-size condition.
The indexing starts at k=0 and is not conflated with a look-ahead method.
Verified the constant-step rule and the source choices alpha=1/L and alpha in (0,2/L).
The interval retains its smooth-convex qualification and is not presented as universally valid.
Verified that exact line search minimizes over positive alpha along the negative current-gradient direction.
The rule is not conflated with an inexact acceptance condition.
Verified the parameter ranges, trial-step contraction, smallest nonnegative m rule and sufficient-decrease inequality.
The inequality direction and squared gradient norm are preserved.
Verified all theorem hypotheses: L-smoothness, convexity, existence of a global minimizer, step size 1/L and k>=1.
The O(1/k) objective-gap bound and coefficient are preserved.
Verified that each convergence bound is paired with its correct step size.
The distance contraction uses alpha=2/(L+mu), while the objective contraction uses alpha=1/L.
The L-smooth and mu-strongly convex assumptions are retained.
Verified that Heavy Ball evaluates the gradient at x_k and uses beta(x_k-x_{k-1}) as momentum.
The beta range and stability qualification are preserved, and the method is not conflated with NAG.
Verified the symmetric-positive-definite quadratic setting, spectral interval and formulas for alpha* and beta*.
The improved condition-number dependence is explicitly restricted to the stated quadratic setting.
Verified initialization y_0=x_0 and lambda_0=1, gradient evaluation at y_k, and all recurrence indices.
The momentum coefficient uses (lambda_k-1)/lambda_{k+1}; no obsolete or off-by-one recurrence is used.
Verified the L-smooth convex assumptions, existence of a global minimizer and dependence on the RC-018 parameterization.
The objective-gap numerator, (k+1)^2 denominator and O(1/k^2) rate are preserved.
Verified the empirical-objective definition, conditional unbiasedness and bounded conditional variance.
Both expectations are conditioned on x_k and the variance bound remains sigma squared.
Verified the stochastic-gradient update and its iteration indices.
The constant-step error-floor statement remains qualitative and retains the persistent-variance and smooth strongly convex qualifications.
Verified the divergent sum of step sizes and convergent sum of squared step sizes.
The item correctly states that these conditions are not sufficient without objective, stochastic-gradient moment, bias and stability assumptions.
Verified v_{-1}=0 initialization, cumulative element-wise squared-gradient update and scaled parameter update.
The epsilon term, k=0 indexing and distinction from exponential averaging are preserved.
Verified v_{-1}=0 initialization, gamma range and exponential moving-average weights.
The update denominator, epsilon term and element-wise operations match the source.
Verified moment initialization, first- and second-moment recurrences, and beta parameter ranges.
The k+1 bias-correction exponents are correct for iterations indexed from k=0.
The final update uses the bias-corrected moments and preserves epsilon.
Verified the gradient linear term, one-half Hessian quadratic term and approximation sign.
The model is not presented as an exact identity for a general objective.
Verified the Hessian linear system, negative-gradient right-hand side and iterate update.
The inverse expression is correctly conditional on Hessian invertibility.
The implementation guidance correctly recommends solving the linear system rather than explicitly forming the inverse.
Verified stationarity, positive-definite Hessian, local Hessian Lipschitz continuity and sufficiently close initialization.
The squared-error recurrence is local and is not presented as a global convergence guarantee.
Verified the definitions of s_k and y_k and their consistent indices.
The secant equation applies the next Hessian approximation to s_k and produces y_k.
Verified the inverse-Hessian BFGS factors, transpose placement, rho definition and positive-curvature condition.
The negative search direction, line-search update and role of the curvature condition are preserved.
